name: ecod_batch_composition

config.model: ECOD fitted on the timestamp arm's benign-only training rows, PyOD defaults; the fit is repeated identically for each batch (ECOD is deterministic, and the timestamp-slice value is asserted to reproduce the archived slice value)
config.batches: timestamp-order held-out slice and day-round-robin held-out slice, 240000 records each, sharing the 78000 evaluated records

RefEcodCompBatchRecords.desc: records in each of the two scoring batches

RefEcodCompSharedRecords.desc: evaluated records common to both batches

RefEcodCompDifferingRecords.desc: records in which the two batches differ

RefEcodCompNaturalBatchAucpr.desc: ECOD AUC-PR on the shared records, timestamp-arm model, timestamp-slice batch (reproduces the Table 6 slice value)

RefEcodCompSyntheticBatchAucpr.desc: ECOD AUC-PR on the shared records, timestamp-arm model, round-robin-slice batch

RefEcodCompNaturalBatchAucroc.desc: ECOD AUC-ROC on the shared records, timestamp-arm model, timestamp-slice batch

RefEcodCompSyntheticBatchAucroc.desc: ECOD AUC-ROC on the shared records, timestamp-arm model, round-robin-slice batch

RefEcodCompDeltaAucpr.desc: AUC-PR difference between the two batches, same model, same size, from reported values

RefEcodCompDeltaAucroc.desc: AUC-ROC difference between the two batches, same model, same size, from reported values

RefEcodCompositionMovesAucpr.desc: 1 if batch content alone, at fixed size and model, changes the reported AUC-PR

RefEcodCompReproducesSlice.desc: 1 if the timestamp-slice value reproduces the archived Table 6 slice-batch value

notes: second referee report, MAJOR 2: batch content varied with size and model fixed; no detector rerun
